metadata.description: Minakami's personal agent plugins for Claude Code and Codex CLI

plugins.name: agent-coord-bootstrap
plugins.description: Scaffold or upgrade an agent-coordination doc layer (AGENTS.md + .agent_works/ + cross-runtime aliases), and review a project's README against best practices for its type. Fresh projects get a clean init; existing projects get a content-preserving migration.

plugins.name: prompt-audit
plugins.description: Audit one prompt's effectiveness for a specific target coding model — token efficiency, goal clarity, confusion/hallucination triggers, capability limiting, and more. Evidence-cited findings tables, an honest verdict, prioritized refinement advice, and an optional approval-gated rewrite. Asks instead of guessing whenever intent is unclear.

plugins.name: code-map
plugins.description: Build an interactive, layered code map of a repository as a local HTML file, every node deep-linked to your editor and every edge citing its source line; and build a code wiki that an agent keeps current with the code: the README as front page, pages that name the source symbols they explain (checked by a lint), a run-and-debug page, rendered diagrams, executable setup commands, and a one-file viewer.
